query:
CREATE TABLE `po_reservations` (
	`id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
	`seller_id` int NOT NULL,
	`seller_name` varchar(200) NOT NULL,
	`codigo_item` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
	`descricao_item` text NOT NULL,
	`purchase_order_item_id` int,
	`po_referencia` varchar(100),
	`quantidade_caixas` decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,
	`data_entrega_prevista` varchar(30),
	`cliente_nome` varchar(300),
	`observacoes` text,
	`status` enum('ativa','cancelada','concluida') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ativa',
	`created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()),
	`updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT (now()) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
	CONSTRAINT `po_reservations_id` PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);
